licence.scope: Site-wide legal notice of the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias (IAC), owner/operator of the Telescopio Carlos Sánchez (level 3: neither the TCS filter page nor the IAC instrumentation page carries a statement on the curve files). It covers the IAC website contents and bars commercial reproduction without IAC permission; it does not name the filter curves. Page SVO cites: http://vivaldi.ll.iac.es/OOCC/iac-managed-telescopes/telescopio-carlos-sanchez/tcs-filters/ (also http://www.iac.es/telescopes/tcs/filtros.htm). The IAC acknowledgement page for Teide telescopes (https://ocan.iac.es/?p=2366) serves an empty body to curl, so no credit line could be verified. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
